# The notch's sand as a QML module (Tacit.Sand): sanditem.cpp plus its GPU programs, generated by gen_shaders.py into
# the build directory (build.sh does both and installs).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(tacitsand LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(Qt6 6.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui GuiPrivate Quick ShaderTools)
qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.8)
qt_add_qml_module(tacitsand
    URI Tacit.Sand
    VERSION 1.0
    PLUGIN_TARGET tacitsand
    OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/qml/Tacit/Sand
    SOURCES sanditem.h sanditem.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(tacitsand PRIVATE Qt6::Quick Qt6::GuiPrivate)
set(SH ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders)
qt_add_shaders(tacitsand "sand_compute" PREFIX "/sand/shaders" BASE ${SH} GLSL "310es,430" NOHLSL NOMSL
    FILES ${SH}/clear.comp ${SH}/insert.comp ${SH}/surfclear.comp ${SH}/surffill.comp ${SH}/copy.comp
          ${SH}/stabilize.comp ${SH}/predict.comp ${SH}/solve.comp ${SH}/vel.comp ${SH}/finish.comp ${SH}/pack.comp)
qt_add_shaders(tacitsand "sand_draw" PREFIX "/sand/shaders" BASE ${SH} GLSL "300es,330" NOHLSL NOMSL
    FILES ${SH}/grain.vert ${SH}/grain.frag)
